newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks low after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks low after U.S. data.

text.p: French share prices were down but off their lows on Tuesday afternoon.
"We're seeing profit-taking on recent gains as the market waits for the new government's policy address" on Thursday, a broker said.
* CAC-40 index down 26.00 or 0.93 pct at 2,769.87 at 1327 GMT after recovering from session low of 2,763.68
* CAC-40 June futures contract down 26 points
* Volume 5.3 billion francs, swelled by block trades

A stream of U.S. data released on Tuesday included higher-than-expected U.S. industrial output and capacity utilisation data for May but slightly lower-than-expected housing starts and consumer prices.
